title: AI Watermarks Explained: What They Can and Cannot Prove
headline:
Can an invisible mark
identify AI media?
meaning: A watermark can signal how content was generated.
example: A detector checks for a supported watermark pattern.
comparison: Finding a mark is different from proving a claim true.
caution: No detected mark does not prove human creation.
question: What would you verify before sharing?
lines: An image can contain a watermark you cannot see. A detector may still be able to find it.
Tools such as Synth I D embed signals in supported A I generated content to help identify its origin.
The signal is part of the content, rather than just a visible logo placed in a corner.
A detected watermark can support an origin claim. It does not prove that the scene or message is true.
And no detected mark does not prove a human made the file. Check sources and context too.
